preconditions: No OBS/VM/product start during the current pause.

fixtureInput.external: none in entrypoint; local i18n and Socket.IO scripts.
fixtureInput.risk: Guide postcondition requires a timer query id; use fixture-timer-{locale} against fake HTTP/socket endpoints only. No database/API seed.

expected.initial: The guide requires ?timer=non-empty; fixture URL uses a reserved synthetic timer id and a fake same-origin response, with no timer record or backend.
expected.update: Only matching data.id updates the timer value/state; the visible countdown must move to 01:29 after a seeded 90-second timer.
expected.negative: Missing timer query produces the source-defined missing-timer diagnostic; nonexistent id must show timer-not-found, not a fabricated active timer.

evidenceRequired: Exact source/package/policy pins, OBS version, and owned portable-config root.
